newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Yaohua plans cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Yaohua plans cash dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass Co have approved to offer a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.15 yuan per share based on 1996 net profit, a company statement said on Tuesday.
An exchange rate for the dividend for foreign currency B shareholders and ex-dividend date will be announced later, the statement said.
The company earlier posted 1996 net profit of 80.39 million yuan, down sharply from 1995's 189.76 million yuan due to fierce competition among domestic glass makers.
